verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Brave Search API offering its own event-triggered rules, such as saved-search alerts, monitors, or webhooks that fire actions. The n8n node and agent-platform guides are host-platform workarounds, and Goggles are re-ranking rules rather than event triggers, so none of these count. A search API could plausibly ship monitoring or alert triggers, so the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.
